capabilities: Play internet radio streams in a sidebar tab
Search about 50,000 stations from the Radio Browser directory by name or genre
Play direct stream URLs in MP3, AAC or Ogg format
Save stations as presets with commands for presets 1-6
Set a sleep timer and use an ASCII equalizer
extras: Renamed from Hi-Fi Tuner in version 1.8.0 (plugin ID unchanged). Marked desktop only because background audio on mobile is unreliable. Requires an internet connection and states there is no telemetry and no account.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to listen to background audio or internet radio while working in a vault.

relations.evidence: With Aurora Clock installed, the glows follow the time of day
with the Static Aurora theme installed, the theme glows in the same colours
pressing play pauses my other players (Static FM, Aurora MP3)
pressing play pauses my other players (Static FM, Aurora MP3)

summary: Internet radio player for the sidebar with a wireframe globe view, search across the Radio Browser directory, presets and a sleep timer.
